part.text:
Fixed. In `StringValueFacetCounts`, when cardinality < 1024 and the collector matched zero docs, `count()` returned early without ever invoking `countOneSegment`, leaving `denseCounts` unallocated and causing NPEs in the read paths. I guarded all three read paths (`lucene/facet/src/java/org/apache/lucene/facet/StringValueFacetCounts.java`):

- `getTopChildren` — skip dense iteration when `denseCounts == null` (returns empty `FacetResult` with `childCount` 0)
- `getAllChildren` — same guard
- `getSpecificValue` — returns `0` when no counts were collected

Verified in the container: `org.apache.lucene.facet.TestStringValueFacetCounts` — all 9 tests pass, including `testEmptyMatchset` (the `MatchNoDocsQuery` regression case covering `getTopChildren`, `getAllChildren`, and `getSpecificValue`) and the existing tests (`testNarrowSingleValued`, `testRandom`, `testCountAll`, etc.).

Note: the container's Gradle 8.8 wrapper download was progressing at ~21KB/s, so I installed the distribution zip from the Huawei Cloud mirror into the wrapper dists cache to unblock the test run.
